Subject: Helio renewal — vendor onboarding refresh + PO workflow

Hi Mateo / Laura,

Hope you’re both well. We’re kicking off our renewal for Helio’s Redwood contract and need to refresh the vendor onboarding materials in your procurement portal before we submit the PO. Two ask areas:  

1) Can you confirm the expected artifacts you need uploaded to the portal for a straight renewal (SOC2, contact details, invoice remit)?
2) We’d like to move to a 12-month term with a 20% capacity uplift for Q3. Please confirm whether that’s possible and any timing constraints we should plan around.

Attached is our latest compliance bundle and a draft mutual action plan (MAP) to speed things up. We’d like to submit the PO by EOD 5/06 if the portal upload goes smoothly. Is there a single person on your team who can help with the portal upload?

Thanks,
Dana
Dana Li
Senior Procurement Lead, Helio Health

Hi Dana — thanks for the packet and MAP. Quick notes:  

- We can support a 12-month term and the requested capacity uplift; I’ll confirm exact throughput numbers after checking the Dedicated capacity pools with Aditya.
- Portal artifacts: SOC 2 report, primary billing contact, W-9 (if US), PO email and invoice remit address, and the signed SOW. We’ll upload anything you share to the Helio portal workspace.

Looping in Laura and Aditya to coordinate approvals and the upload. Laura — can you own the portal upload and signal if we need the escrow/compliance addendum signed? Aditya — can you confirm capacity available for a 20% uplift starting 2026-07-01 and whether a prorated invoice is needed?

I’ve attached a proposed MAP with milestones (upload, PO submission, DocuSign). If that looks good we’ll push the SOW and a DocuSign envelope.

Best,
Mateo Alvarez
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

From: laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>

Date: Mon, 04 May 2026 08:50:00 -07:00
Subject: Internal: Helio renewal — approvals and portal runbook

Team — quick internal checklist before we respond to Dana:  

- Procurement portal workspace: create Helio renewal folder, set reviewer rights to Finance and Legal.
- Required artifacts: SOC2 (received), signed SOW (to be authored), billing contact + W-9 (ask Helio if not already on file), PO field: PO number + submitter email.
- Approval thresholds: Any term change >9 months requires VP Sales approval; capacity uplift >15% requires Ops signoff (Aditya).
- Discounts: Mateo noted standard renewal discount tier vs. upsell tier. We need Aditya to confirm capacity and then I’ll route for VP signoff.

Next steps (today): Aditya to confirm capacity and pricing; Stephanie to prepare the SOW draft and DocuSign envelope once pricing is confirmed; I’ll stand up the portal folder and flag Finance.

Laura Bennett
Head of Renewals, Redwood
From: aditya_rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>

Date: Mon, 04 May 2026 13:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Helio renewal — vendor onboarding refresh + PO workflow

Hi Dana — quick update from capacity and pricing side:  

- Capacity: We can accommodate a 20% uplift starting 2026-07-01 using a combination of Dedicated burst capacity and queued batch windows. I’ll reserve the burst pool to meet the start-of-quarter traffic.
- Pricing/term: A 12-month term is approved. We can extend the renewal discount applied at 10% for the term; an additional 3% upsell credit applies for committed capacity increase (total 13%).
- Docs: Attached is the updated SOW reflecting the term and capacity change. Please sign the DocuSign envelope below to complete the PO path. Once signed, we’ll upload the final SOW and SOC2 to the Helio portal and send final invoice details.

DocuSign: https://docusign.com/embedded-sign/abc123-helio
Attachment: SOW_helio_v3.pdf

Thanks,
Aditya Rao
Director, Capacity & Dedicated Services, Redwood Inference
